text:
Title is in the friend. The gift over to the sister's children is an executory interest that might vest, if the lot were ever used for church purposes, long after any life in being plus 21 years, so the Rule Against Perpetuities voids it. That leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute. I can't accept the team note's options, which give the sister's children a share. Those children could take only if the executory interest were valid, and it isn't.

CONFIDENCE: 85
